Datamatics Global Services to announce Q1FY27 results on 5th August 2026; 
Earnings Call to be held on 6th August at 5:00 PM (IST) 
Datamatics Global Services Ltd. (BSE: 532528), (NSE: DATAMATICS), a global Digital Operations, Technology and 
Experiences company, will announce its first quarter FY27 results on Wednesday, 5th August 2026. The earnings call for 
the results will be held on 6th August at 5:00 PM (IST). The earnings call details will also be available on the company’s 
website, www.datamatics.com 
The Details of Earnings Conference Call are: 
Date: 6th August 2026  
Time (IST): 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM 
Universal Access: +91 22 6280 1107 / 7115 8008 
The number listed above is universally accessible from all networks and all countries 
International Toll-Free Numbers:  
USA – 1 866 746 2133 
UK – 0 808 101 1573 
Singapore – 800 101 2045 
Hong Kong – 800 964 448 
Join with DiamondPass™ Link (No Wait Time) 
https://services.choruscall.in/DiamondPassRegistration/register?confirmationNumber=8032689&linkSecuri
tyString=440b2d40be 
Management Representation: 
Mr. Rahul Kanodia, Vice Chairman & CEO 
Mr. Ankush Akar, EVP and Chief Finance Officer 
Mr. Mitul Mehta, EVP and Chief Marketing Officer 
Participants are requested to log in 10 minutes prior to the start of the scheduled call 
About Datamatics Global Services Limited 
Datamatics (BSE: 532528 | NSE: DATAMATICS) a Digital Operations, Technology and Experiences company that provides 
intelligent solutions for data-driven businesses to increase productivity and enhance the customer experience. With a 
complete digital approach, Datamatics portfolio spans across Digital Technology Solutions, Business Process Management, 
Engineering Services and Big Data & Analytics all powered by Artificial Intelligence. It has established products in Robotic 
Process Automation, Intelligent Document Processing, Business Intelligence and Automated Fare Collection. Datamatics 
services global customers across Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, Manufacturing, International 
Organizations, and Media & Publishing. The Company has presence across 4 continents with major delivery centers in the 
USA, India, and Philippines. To know more about Datamatics, visit www.datamatics.com 
For further information please contact:
